notes: _WNGPart@12 (128 B, 119 code + 9-B census deco). char __stdcall WNGPart(short part, int *p1, int *p2): for (off=0, g=0; off<100; off+=10, g++): n=wingSizes[g]; if (--n >= 0 (cast long, jns)): p=(short*)&wingIds[2*(off+n)]; do-while (n>=0): if(*p==part){ if(p1) *p1=g; if(p2) *p2=n; return 2+((n<1)?-1:0); } p--, n--. Not-found tail: *p1=-1, *p2=-1 (with the p2!=0 guards), return 0. The sbb-ternary lever (w36G note, applied): n typed unsigned long with (long) casts on the >=0 tests so the return materializes as FA's cmp ecx,1 / sbb al,al / add al,2 tail with FA's deferred-pop order (5f/5e around it) - v4 wins with ZERO tail patches, vs v3a (signed n, setl tail) which needed a 15-B tail patch. Signed off + off<100 gives FA's jl 7c form (unsigned off would emit jb 72). Remaining diffs are a reg-plan swap only: CL homes off=ESI/part=DX; FA homes off=EDX/part=SI. Semantic safety: signed-vs-unsigned here is cosmetic (off in 0..100, n in 0..255; the (long) casts restore signed tests; sbb al,al with n unsigned gives exactly CF=(n<u1)=n==0, i.e. return 2 iff n>=1, 1 iff n==0 = FA's semantics).
